sentences.text: Bosnia and Herzegovina -LRB- -LSB- ˈbɒzniə_ənd_ˌhɛərtsəɡoʊˈviːnə , _ - ˌhɜːrt - , _ - ɡə - -RSB- or -LSB- ˌhɜːrtsəˈɡɒvᵻnə -RSB- B&H ; Bosnian , Croatian , Serbian : Bosna i Hercegovina / Боснa и Херцеговина -LSB- bôsna i xěrt͡seɡoʋina -RSB- -RRB- , sometimes called Bosnia-Herzegovina -LRB- BiH -RRB- , and , in short , often known informally as Bosnia , is a country in Southeastern Europe located on the Balkan Peninsula .	Bosnian	Bosnians	Croatian	Croatian language	Serbian	Serbian language	Southeastern Europe	Southeastern Europe	Balkan Peninsula	Balkan Peninsula
Sarajevo is the capital and largest city .	Sarajevo	Sarajevo

Bordered by Croatia to the north , west , and south ; Serbia to the east ; Montenegro to the southeast ; and the Adriatic Sea to the south , with a coastline about 20 km long surrounding the city of Neum .	Croatia	Croatia	Serbia	Serbia	Montenegro	Montenegro	Adriatic Sea	Adriatic Sea	Neum	Neum
In the central and eastern interior of the country the geography is mountainous , in the northwest it is moderately hilly , and the northeast is predominantly flatland .
The inland is a geographically larger region and has a moderate continental climate , with hot summers and cold and snowy winters .	continental climate	continental climate
The southern tip of the country has a Mediterranean climate and plain topography .	Mediterranean climate	Mediterranean climate

Bosnia and Herzegovina is a region that traces permanent human settlement back to the Neolithic age , during and after which it was populated by several Illyrian and Celtic civilizations .	Neolithic	Neolithic	Celtic	Celts

Culturally , politically , and socially , the country has a rich history , having been first settled by the Slavic peoples that populate the area today from the 6th through to the 9th centuries .	Slavic peoples	Slavic peoples

In the 12th century the Banate of Bosnia was established , which evolved into the Kingdom of Bosnia in the 14th century , after which it was annexed into the Ottoman Empire , under whose rule it would remain from the mid-15th to the late 19th centuries .	Banate of Bosnia	Banate of Bosnia	Kingdom of Bosnia	Kingdom of Bosnia	Ottoman Empire	Ottoman Empire
The Ottomans brought Islam to the region , and altered much of the cultural and social outlook of the country .	Ottomans	Ottomans	Islam	Islam in Bosnia and Herzegovina

This was followed by annexation into the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy , which lasted up until World War I .	annexation into the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy	History of Bosnia and Herzegovina (1878–1918)	World War I	World War I

In the interwar period , Bosnia was part of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia and after World War II , the country was granted full republic status in the newly formed Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia .	Federal	Federal republic	republic	republic	Kingdom of Yugoslavia	Kingdom of Yugoslavia	World War II	World War II	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia

Following the dissolution of Yugoslavia , the country proclaimed independence in 1992 , which was followed by the Bosnian War , lasting until late 1995 .	Bosnian	Bosnians	proclaimed independence	Breakup of Yugoslavia#Independence of the Republic of Macedonia and Bosnia and Herzegovina	Bosnian War	Bosnian War	late 1995	Dayton Agreement

Today , the country maintains high literacy , life expectancy and education levels and is one of the most frequently visited countries in the region , projected to have the third highest tourism growth rate in the world between 1995 and 2020 .	most frequently visited countries in the region	Tourism in Bosnia and Herzegovina

Bosnia and Herzegovina is regionally and internationally renowned for its natural beauty and cultural heritage inherited from six historical civilizations , its cuisine , winter sports , its eclectic and unique music , architecture and its festivals , some of which are the largest and most prominent of their kind in Southeastern Europe .	Southeastern Europe	Southeastern Europe	cultural heritage	Culture of Bosnia and Herzegovina	cuisine	Bosnia and Herzegovina cuisine	winter sports	Tourism in Bosnia and Herzegovina#Winter sports	music	Music of Bosnia and Herzegovina	architecture	Architecture of Bosnia and Herzegovina	festivals	Sarajevo#Festivals
The country is home to three main ethnic groups or , officially , constituent peoples , as specified in the constitution .	constituent peoples	Ethnic groups in Bosnia and Herzegovina
Bosniaks are the largest group of the three , with Serbs second and Croats third .	Bosniaks	Bosniaks	Serbs	Serbs of Bosnia and Herzegovina	Croats	Croats of Bosnia and Herzegovina
A native of Bosnia and Herzegovina , regardless of ethnicity , is identified in English as a Bosnian .	Bosnian	Bosnians

The terms Herzegovinian and Bosnian are maintained as a regional rather than ethnic distinction , and the region of Herzegovina has no precisely defined borders of its own .	Bosnian	Bosnians	Herzegovinian	Herzegovinians
Moreover , the country was simply called `` Bosnia '' until the Austro-Hungarian occupation at the end of the 19th century .
Bosnia and Herzegovina has a bicameral legislature and a three-member Presidency composed of a member of each major ethnic group .	bicameral	bicameral

However , the central government 's power is highly limited , as the country is largely decentralized and comprises two autonomous entities : the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and Republika Srpska , with a third region , the Brčko District , governed under local government .	Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina	Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina	Republika Srpska	Republika Srpska	Brčko District	Brčko District

The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina is itself complex and consists of 10 cantons .	Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina	Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina	cantons	Cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina

The country is a potential candidate for membership to the European Union and has been a candidate for North Atlantic Treaty Organisation membership since April 2010 , when it received a Membership Action Plan at a summit in Tallinn .	potential candidate for membership to the European Union	Accession of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the European Union	North Atlantic Treaty Organisation	North Atlantic Treaty Organisation	Membership Action Plan	Membership Action Plan	Tallinn	Tallinn

Additionally , the country has been a member of the Council of Europe since April 2002 and a founding member of the Mediterranean Union upon its establishment in July 2008 .	Council of Europe	Council of Europe	Mediterranean Union	Union for the Mediterranean
